meta.description: Build local BLAST databases and run searches using NCBI BLAST+ command-line tools.
meta.audit_type: directed final pass: archived regression inputs plus two fresh current-source checks
meta.execution_note: Archived Inputs 1-8 reran under BLAST+ 2.17.0+; the stale Input 9 runner was replaced with its equivalent direct current-source checks; two fresh checks covered v4 hard-error behavior and documentation consistency.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: Taxonomy behavior was observed in real BLAST+ 2.17.0+ runs.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill separates technical sequence similarity from clinical diagnosis.

methodological_ground.detail: RBH caveats and taxonomy limitations remain explicit.

code_usability.detail: Bundled wrapper and archived command patterns ran with real BLAST+ output.

functional_suitability.note: The v4/v5 distinction is now accurate and tested with real BLAST+ output.

reliability.note: The silent v5 no-op and loud v4 failure are distinguished with concrete recovery.

performance_context.note: Thread and hitlist limits remain documented; no artificial benchmark claim is made.

agent_usability.note: Task choice, taxonomy prerequisites, and error paths are explicit.

human_usability.note: The table, failure mode, and common-errors surface give consistent guidance.

security.note: No credential, shell-evaluation, or unsafe execution path was introduced.

maintainability.note: The correction updates all affected claims, including the shipped shell example.

agent_specific.note: The Skill gives a concrete decision boundary for v4 versus v5 taxonomy workflows.
